WoW: Forever

Holy Paladin

Plate-wearing single-target healer with party-wide Blessings and auras, and Forever finally gives it an area-healing answer through the new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange100 yd rangeDuration30 secThe caster's next Holy Shock on this target will activate Light's Vigil, healing the target and their party for 324. capstone.

WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Holy build has been tested.

A published level-20 "Holy damage" build spends two points on Improved Holy StrikeImproved Holy StrikeTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec.. Blizzard folded that talent's effect into the class in the September 24 build, dropping Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage.'s cooldown to 10 seconds for everyone, and the client's own Holy Strike row confirms the 10 seconds. The client still carries the talent's separate record, as it does for talents Blizzard has confirmed deleted elsewhere. Blizzard's note is the one to believe, so those two points have nowhere published to go.

No source has posted a level 30 build either. The cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three sites has published one since. So the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs; no guide recommends it.

What Holy is for

Keeping a party standing while in plate, with the mana tools to keep doing it. ReverenceReverenceTalentCastInstantAllows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps a share of your mana regeneration running while you cast. IlluminationIlluminationTalentCastInstant refunds 50% of a spell's base cost when it procs. The new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange100 yd rangeDuration30 secThe caster's next Holy Shock on this target will activate Light's Vigil, healing the target and their party for 324. capstone turns a Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 134 Holy damage to an enemy, or 114 healing to an ally. on a marked ally into a heal for their whole party.

Underneath all of that you are still a melee Paladin: keep a seal up and press Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 12 as Holy damage. and JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. on cooldown.

Forever cut dungeon experience hard, and the October 1 build halved the extra experience on dungeon quests as well. That closes Holy's usual escape hatch: "just level in dungeons" is largely gone.

No source publishes a levelling score for any Paladin spec. A score would only measure solo kill speed, not whether the spec works.

Our own reading, not a sourced one: Holy's output lands on other people. The Blessings, auras and heals all apply to the party, and no talent point in the tree buys damage.

Rotation

Healing:

  1. Flash of LightFlash of LightLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 6Cast1.5 sec castCost35 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 46. as your primary heal, cheap and fast
  2. Holy LightHoly LightLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 9Cast2.5 sec castCost35 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 43. only with mana to spare, on someone in real danger
  3. Lay on HandsLay on HandsLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange40 yd rangeCooldown1200 sec cooldownHeals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration. as the emergency: it heals for your full health and consumes all your mana, so you are finished healing for that fight
  4. Maintain Blessing of MightBlessing of MightLevel 4 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost20 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration3600 secPlaces a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 14 for 3600 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. on the party, plus Devotion AuraDevotion AuraLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledGives 55 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time. or Retribution AuraRetribution AuraLevel 16 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledCauses 7 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.. Live bug as of October 1: Retribution AuraRetribution AuraLevel 16 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledCauses 7 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time. reflects off the target's spell power instead of yours. Blizzard has not called that intended, so treat its output as unreliable until it is fixed

While soloing, your damage rotation is Retribution's minus Seal of CommandSeal of CommandLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost65 ManaDuration30 secGives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 48.5 Holy damage, 97 if the target is stunned or incapacitated..

Multi-target: there effectively is none below 30. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. is expensive, so area healing is spreading Flash of LightFlash of LightLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 6Cast1.5 sec castCost35 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 46. around.

Stat priority

Healing Power, then Intellect, MP5, critical strike, Haste, Spirit.

If you are not planning to heal seriously, gear Weapon Damage, Hit and critical strike instead and play the Holy-damage path.

What Forever changed for Holy

  • Seven new talents, including Voice of TruthVoice of TruthTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration6 secGrants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec. (6 seconds of silence and interrupt immunity), ReverenceReverenceTalentCastInstantAllows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting., Purifying PowerPurifying PowerTalentCastInstantReduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 50%., Infusion of LightInfusion of LightTalentCastInstantDuration15 secYour Holy Shock critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Flash of Light by 0.75 sec or increase the critical chance of your next Holy Light by 10%., Divine PrecisionDivine PrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%., and the Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange100 yd rangeDuration30 secThe caster's next Holy Shock on this target will activate Light's Vigil, healing the target and their party for 324. capstone.
  • Improved SealsImproved SealsTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 3%. replaces Improved Seal of Righteousness. It now buffs all seals and Judgements, but was cut from 5 ranks to 3.
  • The tree was re-laid-out. Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 134 Holy damage to an enemy, or 114 healing to an ally. moved from tier 7 to tier 5. Divine FavorDivine FavorTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledWhen activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance. moved up and no longer needs IlluminationIlluminationTalentCastInstant. IlluminationIlluminationTalentCastInstant now requires ReverenceReverenceTalentCastInstantAllows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting., and its proc refunds 50% of the spell's base cost rather than all of it, on a 20% chance per rank, so 40% at the two points this build spends.
  • ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. left the tree entirely to become baseline at 20 for every spec.

At level 60

Unknown: whether the Holy-damage "Shockadin" path is a real raid specialisation at all. Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantRange100 yd rangeDuration30 secThe caster's next Holy Shock on this target will activate Light's Vigil, healing the target and their party for 324.'s mechanics are no longer in doubt. Wowhead's beta tooltip and both other sources now agree on how the party heal, the subgroup limit and the mana refund work. Nothing published says whether a 51-point Holy build holds up in a level-60 raid.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
